title: AET-B S1: enforcement-surface routing (edits to BADF's enforcement surfaces are C3, declared and actual) + BADF-DEC-0008 opens AET-B

A pinned list in badf_gate.py names the files whose edit changes what BADF enforces or who may authorize it.
